assessment.scope: The pinned OpenITI Arabic transcription, after removal of OpenITI markup and application of the recorded honorific typography map.
assessment.operationalNotice: This is an operational compliance determination, not legal advice. It does not approve expression from comparison witnesses.

sourceBinding.limitation: No reusable facsimile of the OpenITI transcription's 1992 source edition is approved. OpenITI page markers are retained as source metadata but are not represented as scan-verified; the ACO witness is a different edition.

license.rightsBasis: OpenITI distributes its text releases under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0.

limitations: The OpenITI review record reports numerous typographical errors.
OpenITI removed introductions, footnotes, indices, and other paratext in its 2023 cleanup.
Machine alignment is evidence for migration and does not replace human scholarly review.

facsimileAuthority.rightsBasis: Arabic Collections Online states that it believes the displayed materials are in the public domain.
facsimileAuthority.editionRelationship: This four-volume facsimile is an independent public-domain witness. It is not represented as page-identical to the OpenITI transcription's eight-volume source edition.

transformations: Remove OpenITI structural markup while retaining entry and PageVxxPxxx location markers as metadata.
Join source line wraps without changing word order.
Render exact devotional formulas with the reversible typography map in docs/translation-profiles/al-isabah.md.
Bind each emitted Arabic record to the SHA-256 of its rendered public-source text.
restrictedWitnessRule: The former Usul-aligned corpus may be used only as private comparison evidence. Its Arabic, notes, locators, and modern editorial expression may not be emitted into the public corpus.
